ValidationRule.description: An escalated case must carry an escalation level. The case trigger sets one on escalation; this stops it being cleared by hand.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( IsEscalated, OR( ISBLANK(TEXT(Escalation_Level__c)), ISPICKVAL(Escalation_Level__c, "Not Escalated") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: An escalated case needs an escalation level of Level 1 or Level 2.
